label: CSV, no digits, no existing account: a new account is created and linked (no picker needed, no forced re-upload)
CSV, no digits, exactly ONE existing account: reused silently, linked to that account
CSV with declared last digits 7777: a NEW separate account is created (not merged into the first)
CSV, no digits, MULTIPLE accounts: ambiguous (never silently guessed); the document is not linked and a blocking review item is open
picker: resolving with no choice answers needs_choice and lists the candidate accounts (display name + last digits only)
picker: choosing an existing account assigns it on the SAME document (no re-upload); the review item closes
picker: "a different / new account" with last digits creates the account and assigns it on the same document
privacy: no stored account identifier is longer than 6 digits (last digits only)
privacy: a FULL account number (10 digits) is refused, never stored
idempotent: choosing the SAME account again succeeds and changes nothing
a DIFFERENT account after assignment is refused 409 already_assigned_to_other; the link is unchanged
race: two simultaneous different choices -> exactly one winner, the other 409, and the stored link is the winner
wrong currency: an INR account cannot be chosen for an AUD statement (refused, nothing linked)
cross-tenant: User B resolving User A's statement gets exactly the answer a random statement id gets (404)
precondition for the cross-tenant account probe: User B has two accounts and an ambiguous statement
cross-tenant: User B choosing User A's account is indistinguishable from a random account id (404, identical body)
an unresolved statement returns to normal processing once an account is assigned (declared transition; the blocking review item closes)
after assignment the same document processes and its transactions land on the chosen account
